blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Transformer-based models achieve strong performance on blind compressed image restoration (CIR) under unknown compression settings, but their densely stacked projection operators make deployment costly. We study training-free acceleration for such models through an empirical, operator-level analysis. Specifically, we profile where computation is concentrated, characterize channel-wise activation distributions under compressed inputs, and examine the singular-value decay of representative projection weights. These measurements identify the recurring projections in the attention, feed-forward, convolutional, and prompt-conditioning pathways as effective low-rank replacement targets that preserve the original inference graph. They further establish truncated SVD (TSVD) as a principled training-free baseline for blind CIR and reveal why a uniform low-rank objective is mismatched to the channel-imbalanced feature distributions of compressed images. Accordingly, we formulate Activation-Calibrated Singular Value Decomposition (ASVD) for this restoration setting, deriving low-rank factors entirely offline from pretrained weights and lightweight activation statistics gathered from only a few compressed calibration images. By weighting the decomposition with channel-wise activation magnitudes, our ASVD assigns larger penalties to errors on more active channels, requiring neither retraining nor online calibration and leaving the restoration pipeline intact. When instantiated on PromptCIR at rank 64, ASVD consistently improves PSNR-B over TSVD across four standard benchmarks under identical parameter and MAC budgets. At this operating point, the factorized model cuts parameters by 59% (34.75M to 14.34M) and computation by 16.1% (258.79 to 217.16 GMACs for a 256 x 256 input), enabling acceleration without retraining.
blocks.zh: 基于变压器的模型在未知的压缩设置下在盲压缩图像还原(CIR)上实现了强大的性能,但其堆积稠密的投影操作器使得部署成本高昂. 我们通过经验性操作分析,研究这些模型的无培训加速。 具体地说,我们描述计算集中之处,在压缩投入下描述顺道活化分布,并检查代表性投影权重的单值衰减. 这些测量结果将注意力、进取、进取和快速空调路径中反复出现的预测确定为有效的低级替换目标,保留了原来的推论图。 他们进一步将短发SVD(TSVD)作为盲CIR的原则性无训练基线,并揭示一个统一的低级目标为何与被压缩图像的频道-不均匀特征分布不相匹配. 因此,我们为这种恢复设置制定了活化-分解的 Singular 值分解法(ASVD),它完全通过从少数压缩校正图像中收集的被预先训练的重量和轻量级活化统计而得出出低等因素。 通过将分解分解量与信道的活化量进行加权,我们的ASVD对更活化的信道出错分配了更重的处罚,既不要求再培训,也不要求在线校正,使恢复管道完好无损. ASVD在SourceCIR第64等分时,在相同的参数和MAC预算下,将PSNR-B比TSVD改进为四个标准基准。 在这个操作点,因地制宜的模型参数削减了59%(34.75M至14.34M)并计算了16.1%(258.79至217.16GMAC为256×256输入),使得无需再培训即可加速.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Lossy image compression is indispensable for large-scale visual storage and transmission.
JPEG remains one of the most widely deployed standards thanks to its simplicity and broad compatibility, yet aggressive compression inevitably introduces blocking, ringing, and texture loss.
Blind compressed image restoration (CIR) targets this problem by recovering faithful images from compressed inputs without access to the compression quality factor or other degradation parameters.
blocks.zh:
失落的图像压缩对于大规模视觉存储和传输是不可或缺的.
JPEG因其简洁和广泛的兼容性而仍然是应用最广泛的标准之一,然而积极的压缩不可避免地引入了阻塞,振铃,纹理的丧失.
盲压缩图像修复(CIR)通过从压缩输入中恢复忠实的图像,而无法获得压缩质量系数或其他降解参数,来针对这个问题.

blocks.en:
Deep restoration models have substantially advanced blind CIR.
Transformer-based architectures are particularly effective, since self-attention and hybrid attention blocks capture the long-range dependencies that purely local models struggle to represent [ 1 ] .
Representative backbones such as Uformer [ 2 ] , Restormer [ 3 ] , and HAT [ 4 ] have performed well across a range of low-level vision tasks.
For blind CIR, PromptCIR [ 5 ] shows that prompt-based conditioning improves robustness when compression artifacts are unknown and spatially varying.
blocks.zh:
深修复模型有相当先进的盲CIR.
基于变形器的架构特别有效,因为自我关注和混合关注块捕捉到纯粹是当地模型挣扎着代表[1]的长距离依赖.
Uformer[2],Reformer[3],HAT[4]等代表性骨干在一系列低水平的愿景任务上表现良好.
对于盲CIR,ExpointCIR [5] 显示,当压缩文物未知且空间差异大时,即时基调能提高稳健性.

blocks.en:
The architectural choices that raise restoration quality also complicate deployment.
Modern transformer-based CIR models repeatedly apply high-dimensional projection operators in their attention, feed-forward, convolutional-projection, and prompt-conditioning pathways.
Because these operators recur across many scales and layers, they dominate both parameters and computation.
Our profiling of PromptCIR shows that the attention, feed-forward, and convolutional-projection operators alone account for 99.43 % 99.43\% of parameters and 99.89 % 99.89\% of convolutional and linear MACs in the 128 × 128 128\times 128 profiling setting, which makes them the primary targets for acceleration.
For resource-constrained or latency-sensitive pipelines, reducing these projections directly improves efficiency while keeping the surrounding restoration process intact.
blocks.zh:
提高修复质量的建筑选择也使部署复杂化。
基于现代变压器的CIR模型在它们的注意力中反复应用高维度投影操作器,向导进气,向导进气的投影,以及快速的空调路径.
由于这些运算符在许多尺度和层次上反复出现,它们同时主导着参数和计算.
FournalCIR的剖面图显示,光是注意、进取和进化预测操作员就占参数的99.43%,占参数的99.89%;在128×128乘128的剖面图中,占MAC的99.89%。
对于资源紧张或耐久性敏感的管道,减少这些预测直接提高了效率,同时使周围的恢复过程保持完好无损.

blocks.en:
We approach acceleration from this operator-level evidence rather than from a fixed compression recipe.
An effective method should target the repeatedly used projections, preserve the pretrained restoration pipeline, avoid task-specific retraining, and account for channel-dependent behavior under compressed inputs.
We therefore examine activation statistics and singular-value spectra before deciding how to replace these operators.
The spectral analysis points to truncated singular value decomposition (TSVD) as a natural training-free baseline: linear projections and reshaped convolutional projections are written as matrices, decomposed offline, and replaced by two sequential low-rank projections.
Direct TSVD, however, treats all channels uniformly under an unweighted matrix objective.
This assumption is restrictive for restoration, since compressed-image features exhibit markedly nonuniform channel magnitudes tied to artifacts, textures, and prompt-conditioned information.
blocks.zh:
我们从这个操作者层面的证据 而不是从固定的压缩配方来加速
有效的方法应针对反复使用的预测,保留事先经过训练的恢复管道,避免针对具体任务的再培训,并在压缩投入下说明依赖信道的行为。
因此,我们在决定如何替换这些操作人员之前,先审查激活统计和单值光谱。
光谱分析指向切变单值分解(TSVD)作为自然无训练基线:线性预测和重塑的转录预测被写成矩阵,分解离线,并被两个相继的低阶预测所取代.
然而,直接TSVD在未加权矩阵目标下统一处理所有频道.
这种假设对恢复是限制性的,因为压缩图像特征显示出显著的非统一通道尺寸,与文物、纹理和迅速有条件的信息相连。

blocks.en:
Guided by these observations, we design Activation-Calibrated Singular Value Decomposition (ASVD) as a projection-level acceleration method for transformer-based blind CIR.
The method first expresses the selected linear and convolutional projections in a unified matrix form.
TSVD then provides a closed-form, training-free low-rank baseline grounded in the Eckart–Young theorem [ 6 ] .
Building on this baseline, our ASVD uses lightweight input and output activation statistics collected from a small set of compressed calibration images to weight the decomposition.
The resulting low-rank factors are produced entirely offline and inserted back into the pretrained network, requiring no ground-truth restored images, no retraining, no prompt redesign, and no online calibration.
blocks.zh:
在这些观测的指引下,我们设计了激活-解析的Singular值分解(ASVD)作为变压器盲CIR的投影级加速方法.
该方法首先以统一的矩阵形式表达选定的线性和演化预测.
TSVD随后提供了一个基于Eckart–Young定理[6]的封闭式,无训练的低阶基线.
在这个基线的基础上,我们的ASVD使用从一小组压缩校准图像中收集的轻量级输入和输出激活统计数据来加权分解.
由此产生的低等级因素完全脱线,重新插入经过预先训练的网络,不需要地面真实恢复的图像、不进行再培训、不迅速重新设计和不进行在线校准。

blocks.en: We instantiate the framework on PromptCIR, a representative prompt-based blind CIR model, and evaluate it on standard blind CIR benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们即刻在具有代表性的即时盲目CIR模型上建立框架,并根据标准的盲目CIR基准进行评估。

blocks.en: At rank 64, ASVD improves PSNR-B over TSVD across all four benchmarks while maintaining comparable PSNR and SSIM under identical parameter and MAC budgets.
blocks.zh: 在64级,ASVD将PSNR-B比TSVD改进到所有四个基准,同时在相同的参数和MAC预算下保持可比的PSNR和SSIM.

blocks.en: The main contributions are summarized as follows: • We present a training-free, projection-level low-rank acceleration formulation for transformer-based blind CIR. Operator profiling and singular-value analysis identify the dominant replacement targets and establish TSVD as an architecture-preserving baseline. • We design ASVD to address the channel imbalance observed in compressed-image feature activations. Our decomposition draws on lightweight statistics from compressed calibration inputs to emphasize activation-sensitive channels, without paired targets or retraining. • We instantiate the method on PromptCIR and evaluate it against the original backbone and TSVD. The results show consistent PSNR-B improvements over TSVD at rank 64 under the same parameter and MAC budgets, while leaving the surrounding restoration pipeline unchanged.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献概述如下: 我们为变压器盲式CIR提出无训练、投影低级加速配方。 操作者剖析和单值分析确定主要替换目标,并将TSVD确定为结构保护基线。 我们设计ASVD以解决在压缩图像特性激活中观察到的信道不平衡. 我们的分解利用压缩校准投入的轻量级统计数据,强调对激活敏感的渠道,不配对目标或再培训。 利用原始主干和TSVD来评估 结果显示,在相同的参数和MAC预算下,PSNR-B比TSVD在64级有一致的改进,而周围的恢复管道保持不变.

blocks.en: We present a training-free, projection-level low-rank acceleration formulation for transformer-based blind CIR. Operator profiling and singular-value analysis identify the dominant replacement targets and establish TSVD as an architecture-preserving baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们为变压器盲式CIR提出无训练、投影低级加速配方。 操作者剖面和单值分析确定主导替换目标,并将TSVD确定为架构保留基准.

blocks.en: We design ASVD to address the channel imbalance observed in compressed-image feature activations. Our decomposition draws on lightweight statistics from compressed calibration inputs to emphasize activation-sensitive channels, without paired targets or retraining.
blocks.zh: 我们设计ASVD以解决在压缩图像特性激活中观察到的信道不平衡. 我们的分解利用压缩校准投入的轻量级统计数据,强调对激活敏感的渠道,不配对目标或再培训。

blocks.en: We instantiate the method on PromptCIR and evaluate it against the original backbone and TSVD. The results show consistent PSNR-B improvements over TSVD at rank 64 under the same parameter and MAC budgets, while leaving the surrounding restoration pipeline unchanged.
blocks.zh: 利用原始主干和TSVD来评估 结果显示,在相同的参数和MAC预算下,PSNR-B比TSVD在64级有一致的改进,而周围的恢复管道保持不变.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Compressed Image Restoration
blocks.zh: II-A 压缩图像修复

blocks.en:
Compressed image restoration (CIR) targets artifacts caused by quantization and transform loss.
Early approaches relied on transform-domain priors or dual-domain modeling [ 7 ] , using handcrafted assumptions to recover information lost to compression.
blocks.zh:
压缩图像修复(CIR)针对的是量化和变形损失导致的文物.
早期的方法依赖于变形域前传或双域模型[7],使用手工的假设来恢复压缩损失的信息.

blocks.en:
CNN-based methods later pushed CIR performance further.
ARCNN [ 8 ] demonstrated the effectiveness of convolutional networks for artifact reduction, while dual-domain designs such as D3 [ 9 ] and DMCNN [ 10 ] exploited complementary representations in the pixel and transform domains, following the residual learning paradigm [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] .
Attention-enhanced CNN restorers further improved representation capacity through channel and non-local modeling [ 15 , 16 ] , while quantization-guided designs injected JPEG side information [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh:
基于CNN的方法后来进一步推动了CIR的性能.
ARCNN [8] 证明了减少文物的革命网络的有效性,而D3 [9] 和DMCNN [10] 等双重领域设计则按照残余的学习范式,利用了像素和变换领域的互补表述[11,12,13,14].
注意加强 CNN恢复器通过频道和非本地模型[15,16]进一步提高了表现能力,同时量化-导设计注入JPEG侧面信息[17].

blocks.en:
More recently, transformer-based architectures have become popular restoration backbones, owing to the global modeling capability of self-attention [ 18 ] .
Representative models such as SwinIR [ 19 ] , Uformer [ 2 ] , Restormer [ 3 ] , and HAT [ 4 , 20 ] handle long-range dependencies and complex artifact patterns effectively, while Stripformer [ 21 ] and NAFNet [ 22 ] improve efficiency through structured attention or simplified operators.
State-space restoration backbones such as MambaIR [ 23 ] offer another route to efficient long-range modeling.
This progression has been evaluated across diverse restoration benchmarks and datasets [ 1 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] .
However, the gains of these backbones come largely from stacking high-dimensional projection and attention operators, whose cost grows rapidly with feature width and token length, making efficient deployment a recurring concern.
blocks.zh:
最近,由于自留心的全球建模能力[18],基于变压器的建筑已成为流行的修复骨干.
SwinIR[19],Uformer等代表性模型 [2],重暴者[3],HAT[4,20]有效处理远程依赖和复杂的文物图案,而Strapformer[21]和NAFNet[22]则通过有条理的注意或简化操作员提高效率.
MambaIR[23]等国有空间恢复骨干为高效远程建模提供了另一条路线.
这一进展已通过各种恢复基准和数据集[1、24、25、26、27]加以评价。
然而,这些主干网的收益主要来自叠加高维投影和注意操作器,其成本随地物宽度和象征性长度而迅速增长,使得高效部署成为反复出现的问题.

blocks.en:
The blind CIR setting poses additional challenges, because the compression artifacts are unknown and spatially varying.
To improve robustness, prior work incorporates auxiliary cues or representation learning strategies, including quality-factor-aware modeling [ 28 ] and contrastive representation learning [ 29 ] .
More recently, prompt-based conditioning has emerged as an effective way to handle diverse degradations, with prompt-conditioned transformers proving effective in both all-in-one and blind CIR settings, including PromptIR [ 30 ] , PromptCIR [ 5 ] , ProRes [ 31 ] , PromptRR [ 32 ] , Prompt-in-Prompt [ 33 ] , DA-CLIP [ 34 ] , and visual or multimodal prompt learning methods [ 35 , 36 , 37 ] .
Related compressed-image restoration and super-resolution efforts, including UCIP [ 38 ] , MambaCSR [ 39 ] , and CODiff [ 40 ] , further show the importance of compression-aware conditioning.
Such prompt conditioning introduces additional projection pathways that interact with the backbone, further enlarging the operator budget that any acceleration method must address.
blocks.zh:
盲目的CIR设置带来了额外的挑战,因为压缩文物是未知的,在空间上也是不同的.
为提高稳健性,前期工作纳入了辅助提示或代表性学习战略,包括质量要素意识模型[28]和对比性代表性学习[29]。
最近,迅速调制已成为处理各种退化的有效方法,迅速调制的变压器在全一和全盲的CIR环境中证明是有效的,包括PourneIR [30],PourneCIR [5], ProRes [31], ExpressRR [32], Express-in-Prompt [33], DA-CLIP [34], 以及视觉或多式联运的即时学习方法 [35, 36, 37].
相关的压缩图像修复和超解析努力,包括UCIP [38],MambaCSR [39],以及CODIff [40],进一步显示了压缩感知调节的重要性.
这种即时调节引入了与主干相互作用的额外预测路径,进一步扩大了任何加速方法必须处理的操作员预算。

blocks.en: II-B Model Compression and Acceleration
blocks.zh: II-B 模型压缩和加速

blocks.en:
Model efficiency has been studied extensively through pruning, quantization, and low-rank approximation [ 41 , 42 , 43 , 44 ] .
Among these, low-rank approximation offers a principled and training-free route to reducing computation, grounded in the classical Eckart–Young theorem [ 6 ] .
Classical CNN acceleration methods showed that convolutional redundancy can be exploited through low-rank or tensor factorization [ 45 , 46 , 47 ] .
Recent works revisit truncated SVD for large neural networks and propose truncation-aware [ 48 ] or importance-weighted and Fisher-weighted variants [ 49 ] to improve approximation fidelity.
A shared insight is that raw weight-reconstruction error is an incomplete objective, since channels contribute unequally to the layer output; this motivates activation- or importance-aware reweighting of the decomposition objective.
blocks.zh:
通过挤压,量化,低级近似[41,42,43,44]对模型效率进行了广泛的研究.
其中,低级近似为减少计算提供了一条原则性的和无培训的路线,基于古典埃卡特—青年定理[6].
古典的CNN加速方法表明,通过低阶或高压的阶梯化,可以利用演化冗余[45,46,47].
近期的作品重温了大型神经网络的截断SVD,并提出截断-意识[48]或重要加权和费舍加权变体[49],以提高近似忠诚度.
一个共同的洞察力是原始重力重建错误是一个不完整的目标,因为渠道对层层输出的贡献是不平等的;这激励着对分解目标的激活-或重视-重力.

blocks.en:
In parallel, training-free acceleration techniques for iterative generative models exploit feature reuse and operator-level approximation.
Representative examples include DeepCache [ 50 ] , block-wise caching [ 51 ] , and channel-aware SVD acceleration for diffusion transformers [ 52 ] .
Other cache-based or training-free variants further explore layer caching, token-wise feature reuse, fast-forward caching, and delta updates [ 53 , 54 , 55 , 56 , 57 ] .
Although developed mainly for diffusion models, these approaches reinforce calibration and operator-level approximation as practical tools for training-free acceleration.
blocks.zh:
同时,用于迭代基因模型的无培训加速技术利用特征再利用和操作员级近似。
具有代表性的例子包括DeepCache [50],块式缓冲[51],以及用于扩散变压器的通道-意识SVD加速[52].
其他基于缓存或无培训的变体进一步探索了层缓存,符号特征再利用,快速前导缓存,以及三角洲更新[53,54,55,56,57].
虽然这些方法主要是为推广模式而开发的,但加强了校准和操作者一级近似,作为无培训加速的实用工具。

blocks.en: We develop a training-free acceleration scheme for PromptCIR-based blind CIR that calibrates projection factorization using activation magnitudes from compressed images. The resulting diagonal scaling provides a lightweight alternative to truncation-aware whitening [ 48 ] and Fisher-weighted objectives [ 49 ] . Whereas channel-aware decomposition for diffusion transformers supports cache correction [ 52 ] , our factors directly replace spatial and prompt-conditioning projections, preserving the restoration pipeline without retraining.
blocks.zh: 我们为基于PowerCIR的盲式CIR开发一个无训练加速计划,利用压缩图像的激活量校准投影因子化. 由此形成的对角缩放提供了一种轻量级的替代品,可以取代短发-感光白化[48]和费舍尔加权目标[49]. 而用于扩散变压器的通道-意识分解支持缓存校正[52],而我们的因素直接取代了空间和快速空调预测,在不进行再培训的情况下保留了恢复管道.

blocks.en: III Motivation and Design Rationale
blocks.zh: 三. 动机和设计理由

blocks.en:
We derive the projection-level SVD design from an empirical analysis of transformer-based blind CIR.
The analysis is organized around three questions: which operators dominate the cost, whether their weights admit a compact low-rank approximation, and whether compressed-image activations justify channel-aware weighting.
The answers determine our method design: projection operators define the replacement unit, TSVD supplies the training-free baseline, and ASVD supplies activation-aware weighting.
blocks.zh:
我们从对变压器盲CIR的经验分析中得出投影级SVD设计.
分析围绕三个问题进行:哪个操作者主导成本,它们的权重是否承认一个紧凑的低级近似,压缩图像激活是否证明频道感知权重是合理的.
答案决定了我们的方法设计:投影操作者定义了替换单元,TSVD提供无训练基线,ASVD提供激活-感知加权.

blocks.en: III-A Projection Operators as the Replacement Unit
blocks.zh: 作为替换股的投影操作员

blocks.en:
Prompt-based transformer restoration models contain many projection operators, including query-key-value projections, output projections, feed-forward expansions and reductions, point-wise convolutional projections, and prompt-conditioning projections.
These modules are invoked repeatedly across the encoder, bottleneck, and decoder stages.
They share a unified matrix representation: a linear layer is already a matrix, and a convolution kernel can be reshaped into a two-dimensional operator.
This common representation localizes the replacement while preserving the architecture.
blocks.zh:
即时变压器恢复模型包含许多投影操作器,包括查询键值预测,产出预测,向导扩展和减少,点向演化预测,以及即时空调预测.
这些模块在编码器、瓶颈和解码器阶段反复被引用。
他们共享一个统一的矩阵表示:线性层已经是一个矩阵,一个演化内核可以重塑成二维操作符.
这种共同代表制在保留建筑的同时将替换本地化.

blocks.en:
The cost profile in Fig. 1 (a) shows that this choice is not merely convenient algebraically but also meaningful for efficiency.
In the profiled PromptCIR model, attention projections, feed-forward projections, and convolutional-projection layers together account for 99.43 % 99.43\% of parameters and 99.89 % 99.89\% of convolutional and linear MACs at 128 × 128 128\times 128 , so replacement can concentrate on these operators rather than on the non-dominant modules.
Prompt-conditioning operators are far smaller in aggregate, yet we retain them within the unified formulation because they govern degradation-conditioned feature modulation.
Replacing selected projections is also far less intrusive than redesigning attention blocks.
The surrounding normalization, nonlinearity, skip-connection, and prompt-conditioning logic can remain unchanged, while each dense projection is realized by two low-rank factors.
This locality is essential in an offline replacement setting, where the compressed model must reproduce the pretrained restoration mapping as closely as possible.
blocks.zh:
图1(a)中的成本概况表明,这种选择不仅方便代数,而且对效率有意义。
在剖面的FourceCIR模型中,注意力预测,向导预测,以及演化-预测层加在一起占参数的99.43% 99.43%和演化和线性MAC的99.89% 99.89% 128×128\times 128,所以替换可以集中在这些操作器上,而不是非支配模块上.
快速空调操作器的总和要小得多,但我们将其保留在统一配制中,因为它们管理降解条件的特性调制。
取代选定的预测也远不如重新设计关注区块那样具有侵扰性。
周围的正常化,非线性,跳转连接,以及即时调节逻辑可以保持不变,而每个密集的预测则通过两个低级因素实现.
这个位置对于离线替换环境至关重要,在这种环境中,压缩模型必须尽可能紧密地复制经过事先训练的恢复图。

blocks.en: III-B Spectral Evidence for SVD-Based Replacement
blocks.zh: 用于基于 SVD 的替换的光谱证据

blocks.en:
After identifying the replacement unit, we examine whether SVD is a reasonable low-rank mechanism for these operators.
SVD satisfies the deployment constraints imposed by the pretrained restoration model: it can be computed offline from pretrained weights, yields the optimal rank- r r approximation under the standard Frobenius objective, and applies uniformly to linear projections and reshaped convolution kernels.
It preserves the surrounding inference graph, since each original projection is replaced by two sequential low-rank projections with the same tensor interface.
blocks.zh:
在确定替换单位后,我们审查SVD是否是这些运营商的合理低级机制.
SVD满足了预先训练的修复模型所施加的部署限制:它可以从预先训练的重量下线计算出来,产生标准Frobenius目标下的最佳军衔-r 近似值,并统一适用于线性预测和重塑的演化内核.
它保留了周围的推论图,因为每个原始投影都被两个相继的低阶投影所取代,并且具有相同的拉诺接口.

blocks.en:
The singular-value analysis in Fig. 1 (c) shows why SVD is an appropriate starting point but not a complete design.
Representative projection operators exhibit measurable spectral concentration, but its degree varies across operator families: the mean rank needed to preserve 95 % 95\% of the spectral energy, defined as the sum of squared singular values, ranges from 47.93 % 47.93\% for prompt linear projections to 86.47 % 86.47\% for GDFN projections.
This evidence supports SVD-based replacement while indicating that rank must be analyzed explicitly.
First, TSVD is a principled baseline because it tests how much of the pretrained projection behavior a bounded-rank subspace can capture.
Second, because uniform low-rank replacement is not equally effective for all projections, rank and operator selection should be evaluated explicitly rather than fixed globally.
blocks.zh:
图1(c)中的单值分析显示了为什么SVD是一个合适的起点,而不是一个完整的设计.
具有代表性的投影操作者表现出可测量的光谱浓度,但其程度因操作者家族而异:为保存95%的光谱能量(定义为平方单数之和)所需的平均级别从47.93%的47.93%的快速线性预测到86.47%的86.47%的GDFN预测.
这种证据支持基于SVD的替换,同时表示必须明确分析军衔.
首先,TSVD是一个原则性的基准,因为它测试一个边际排名的子空间能捕捉到多少预先训练的投影行为.
第二,由于统一的低级别替换对所有预测不具有同等效力,因此应明确评价排名和操作员选择,而不是全球固定。

blocks.en: III-C Channel Statistics Under Compressed Inputs
blocks.zh: 三-C 压缩输入下的频道统计

blocks.en:
TSVD provides the low-rank baseline, but its objective is uniform over channels.
For blind CIR, this assumption deserves scrutiny because the network must preserve spatially precise structures while suppressing compression artifacts.
As compressed images pass through a restoration transformer, different channels carry different amounts of artifact, texture, and prompt-conditioned information.
We therefore inspect the activation statistics of high-cost projections using a small compressed calibration set.
blocks.zh:
TSVD提供低级基线,但其目标在频道上一致.
对于盲目的CIR来说,这一假设值得仔细审查,因为网络必须保留空间精确的结构,同时压制压缩文物.
随着压缩的图像通过一个恢复变压器,不同的通道携带着不同数量的文物,纹理,以及快速条件的信息.
因此,我们利用一套小型的压缩校准来检查高成本预测的启动统计。

blocks.en:
The observed activation distributions are markedly nonuniform.
For several window-attention, multi-Dconv head transposed attention (MDTA), gated-Dconv feed-forward network (GDFN), and output-projection families, 50 % 50\% of the output activation energy, defined as the sum of squared per-channel activation magnitudes, concentrates in only 17.39 % 17.39\% – 23.76 % 23.76\% of the channels, whereas prompt-related and some overlap-attention projections are less concentrated.
Such heterogeneity means that a single unweighted objective treats all channels alike even when their activation magnitudes differ sharply under compressed inputs, which makes uniform channel treatment restrictive.
If a high-activation channel is poorly approximated, the resulting error can propagate through the restoration features far more strongly than an error on a weakly activated channel.
blocks.zh:
观察到的激活分布明显不统一.
对于几个窗口注意,多Dconv头移位注意(MDTA),Gated-Dconv feed-forward network(GDFN),以及输出-预测家族,50%的输出激活能量被定义为每通道激活量的平方总和,只集中在17.39 % 17.39 % – 23.76 % 23.76 % 的通道中,而与即时相关的和某些重叠的预测则不那么集中.
这种异质性意味着,一个单一的无加权目标对待所有信道都是一样的,即使其激活量在压缩输入下差异很大,这使得统一的信道处理受到限制。
如果高活性信道的近似性差,由此产生的误差可以通过恢复特性传播,比弱激活信道的误差强得多。

blocks.en:
Our ASVD uses this observation as calibration information rather than as a training signal.
The collected statistics neither optimize a restoration loss, nor rely on ground-truth restored images, nor modify the model online.
Instead, they define diagonal scaling factors that give activation-dominant input and output channels greater influence within a deterministic offline replacement procedure.
blocks.zh:
我们的ASVD将这种观察作为校准信息而不是训练信号.
收集的统计数据既不优化恢复损失,也不依赖地面真实恢复的图像,也不在网上修改模型。
相反,它们界定了对角缩放因子,在决定性离线替换程序范围内,使激活-支配性输入和输出渠道具有更大的影响力。

blocks.en: III-D From Analysis to ASVD
blocks.zh: 三-D 从分析到ASVD

blocks.en:
These observations define a two-step replacement strategy.
Projection-level replacement targets the dominant cost centers while keeping the pretrained restoration pipeline intact.
The spectral results support TSVD as a closed-form low-rank baseline for these matrix-representable operators.
The activation results then motivate ASVD, our factor-generation refinement that introduces activation-derived channel weights so that channels more active under compressed inputs gain greater influence in the weighted approximation objective.
At a fixed rank, TSVD and ASVD share the same inference-time structure, parameter count, and MACs; comparing them therefore isolates the effect of activation-calibrated factor generation under an identical deployment budget.
blocks.zh:
这些意见确定了两步更换战略。
预测级替换针对主要成本中心,同时保持预先训练的恢复管道完好无损。
光谱结果支持TSVD作为这些矩阵可代表操作器的闭式低级基线.
激活结果随后激发了ASVD, 我们的因子生成改进引入了激活衍生通道权重,这样在压缩投入下更活跃的通道在加权近似目标上获得了更大的影响力.
在固定的级别上,TSVD和ASVD共享相同的推论时间结构,参数计数,以及MAC;因此比较它们会隔离在相同的部署预算下激活校正因子生成的效果.

The analysis in Sec. III leads to an operator-replacement formulation: selected projections are replaced by two low-rank factors generated offline from pretrained weights and, in our ASVD variant, lightweight activation statistics.

blocks.en:
We instantiate both variants on PromptCIR [ 5 ] , whose residual hybrid attention groups and transformer-style feed-forward blocks contain extensive projections across the encoder, bottleneck, decoder, and prompt-conditioning pathways.
Selected operators are replaced offline, while surrounding modules, prompts, normalization layers, nonlinearities, and inference procedures remain unchanged.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the framework on four blind compressed image restoration benchmarks: LIVE1 [ 58 ] , BSDS500 [ 59 ] , ICB [ 26 ] , and DIV2K [ 25 ] .

blocks.en: V-B Comparison with Representative Methods

blocks.en:
Table I reports quantitative comparisons on the four benchmarks.
Both TSVD and ASVD substantially reduce the parameter count, with restoration fidelity increasing as the rank budget grows.
blocks.zh:
表一报告了四个基准的定量比较。
TSVD和ASVD都大幅降低了参数计数,随着军衔预算的增长,恢复忠诚度不断提高.

blocks.en: At rank 64, ASVD improves PSNR-B over TSVD by 0.12 0.12 – 0.24 0.24 dB across all four benchmarks, with comparable PSNR and SSIM at identical parameter and MAC budgets. The PSNR differences between the two methods are below 0.10 0.10 dB. At ranks 96 and 128, both methods approach the restoration performance of the original model.
blocks.zh: 在64级,ASVD将PSNR-B比TSVD提高0.12 0.12 – 0.24 0.24 dB所有四个基准,在相同的参数和MAC预算上具有可比的PSNR和SSIM. 两种方法的PSNR差异低于0.100.10 dB. 在第96和第128名中,这两种方法都接近原型号的恢复性能.

blocks.en: ASVD reduces the parameter count by 59 % 59\% at rank 64. At rank 96, it retains a 47 % 47\% parameter reduction while keeping PSNR within 0.13 0.13 dB of PromptCIR across all four benchmarks. On BSDS500, ranks 96 and 128 yield a small PSNR improvement of approximately 0.03 0.03 dB. Such improvements are possible because minimizing projection error does not impose a fixed ordering on the final restoration error. The corresponding computational savings and measured latency are reported in Table VII .

blocks.en: At rank 32, bilateral weighting has the highest mean PSNR, SSIM, and PSNR-B among the tested variants. At rank 64, input-only weighting performs better, with the square-root variant attaining the highest restoration metrics and the lowest output NMSE. The output NMSE and final restoration metrics need not induce the same ordering, because the former measures local projection errors rather than the nonlinear network output.

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The empirical results support the analysis-driven acceleration scheme.
The profiling and spectral evidence in Fig. 1 identify projection operators as the dominant source of cost and show that their weights contain exploitable low-rank structure.
Table I demonstrates the effectiveness of activation-calibrated factor generation. At rank 64, ASVD improves PSNR-B over TSVD on all four benchmarks under identical parameter and MAC budgets.
This connects the motivation to evaluation: TSVD tests compact projection approximations, while the channel imbalance in Fig. 1 (b) motivates activation-calibrated factor selection.
blocks.zh:
实证结果支持了分析驱动的加速计划.
图1中的剖面和光谱证据将投影操作者确定为成本的主要来源,并表明其重量包含可开发的低级结构。
表一显示激活校准系数生成的有效性。 在64级,ASVD改进了PSNR-B比TSVD在相同参数和MAC预算下的所有四个基准.
这将动机与评价联系起来:TSVD测试紧凑的投影近似,而图1(b)中的通道不平衡则激发激活-校准因子选择.

blocks.en:
The rank ablation in Table II further clarifies the role of activation calibration.
At very small ranks, the factorized operators have limited capacity, and the choice of retained subspace determines most of the restoration error.
The weighted objective favors preservation of active channels. ASVD achieves its largest DIV2K PSNR gain over TSVD at rank 32 and consistently improves PSNR-B at rank 64, with comparable PSNR and SSIM.
As the rank grows, both decompositions recover a larger fraction of the pretrained operator, and the gap between TSVD and ASVD naturally narrows.
This trend distinguishes ASVD from runtime augmentation: it improves the offline factor selection under the same rank and complexity budget.
The feature visualizations in Fig. 4 provide representation-level evidence, with ASVD producing lower and more coherent errors on high-activation channels.
blocks.zh:
表二中的降级进一步明确了激活校准的作用.
在非常小的排位上,被要素化的操作员的容量有限,选择保留子空间决定了大多数的恢复错误.
加权目标有利于保留活动渠道。 ASVD在TSVD排名第32位实现最大的DIV2K PSNR增益,并在64位持续改进PSNR-B,具有类似的PSNR和SSIM.
随着军衔的提高,两种分解都恢复了预训操作员的较大比例,TSVD和ASVD之间的差距自然缩小.
这一趋势将ASVD与运行时间增强区分开来:它改善了同级和复杂预算下的离线因素选择.
图4中的特征可视化提供了表现层面的证据,ASVD在高活性通道上产生较低且更连贯的错误.

blocks.en:
The calibration-size study in Table III supports the use of a small compressed calibration set.
The statistics used by our ASVD are per-channel activation magnitudes rather than task-loss gradients or reconstructed-image supervision; they simply measure which input and output channels respond more strongly when the pretrained model processes compressed images.
The multi-seed results indicate that a small set can stabilize these coarse channel weights, with performance approximately plateauing around 8 8 – 16 16 images.
The quality-range study also shows low sensitivity to the tested calibration distributions. This stability supports blind CIR, where the model restores compressed inputs without receiving their JPEG quality factors.
blocks.zh:
表三中的校准尺寸研究支持使用小型压缩校准集.
我们ASVD使用的统计数据是每个通道的激活量,而不是任务损失梯度或重建图像监督;它们只是测量在预先训练的模型处理压缩图像时,输入和输出渠道的反应更强烈.
多种子的结果表明,一个小集可以稳定这些粗细的通道权重,性能大约在8 8 – 16 个图像上稳定.
质量测距研究也显示对测试的校准分布的敏感性较低. 这种稳定性支持盲目CIR,其中模型在不接收其JPEG质量因素的情况下恢复压缩输入.

blocks.en:
The operator-level formulation in Fig. 2 keeps the accelerated model close to the original restoration backbone.
Each selected projection is replaced locally by two factors, while attention reshaping, prompt interaction, normalization, nonlinear activation, skip connections, and output reconstruction remain unchanged.
This locality avoids conflating low-rank replacement with architectural redesign and enables a controlled comparison: at a fixed rank, TSVD and ASVD share the same parameter count, MACs, tensor interfaces, and inference graph.
Consequently, their observed difference is attributable to activation-calibrated factor generation rather than topology or runtime computation.
blocks.zh:
图2中的操作层配方保持加速模型接近原恢复主干线.
每个选定的投影都在当地被两个因素所取代,而注意力重塑,即时互动,正常化,非线性激活,跳过连接,以及输出重建则保持不变.
这个位置避免了将低阶重置与建筑重新设计混为一谈,并可以进行控制比较:在固定的级别上,TSVD和ASVD共享相同的参数计数,MAC,拉诺接口,以及推论图.
因此,它们观察到的差异可归因于激活校准系数生成,而不是地形或运行时间计算。

blocks.en:
The choice of the rank- 64 64 operating point follows the same evidence in Tables II and VII .
It reduces parameters by 58.75 % 58.75\% and MACs by 16.09 % 16.09\% relative to the original PromptCIR backbone. Rank 96 reduces parameters by 46.93 % 46.93\% but MACs by only 1.70 % 1.70\% ; rank 128 exceeds the original MAC count by 1.70 % 1.70\% .
Higher ranks are useful for demonstrating the convergence of TSVD and ASVD and for retaining restoration fidelity, but offer less arithmetic reduction.
Rank 64 provides a compact model with measurable PSNR-B improvements over TSVD, while rank 96 offers restoration performance close to the original backbone.
At rank 96, the PSNR difference from the original model ranges from − 0.13 -0.13 to + 0.03 +0.03 dB, illustrating the complementary higher-fidelity operating regime.
blocks.zh:
等级的选择 -- 64 64 操作点遵循表二和七中的同样证据。
相对于原始的PowerCIR主干线,它将参数减少58.75% 58.75%,MAC减少16.09% 16.09%. 96级将参数减少46.93% 46.93\%,但MAC只减少1.70% 1.70\%;128级比最初的MAC计数多1.70% 1.70\%.
较高的级别有助于表明TSVD和ASVD的趋同,并有助于保持恢复忠贞,但减少算术。
排名64提供了一个紧凑的模型,比TSVD有可测量的PSNR-B改进,而排名96提供了接近原始主干线的恢复性能.
在96级中,PSNR与原始型号的区别范围为−0.13-0.13至+0.03+0.03 dB,说明了互补的更高性能操作制度.

blocks.en:
The method also offers a favorable deployment profile.
All factor generation is performed offline, and the compressed model retains the original PromptCIR topology, prompts, normalization layers, and restoration head.
ASVD is therefore complementary to pruning and quantization: it reduces the algebraic cost of dense projections while leaving precision reduction and sparsity-based acceleration available for deployment.
blocks.zh:
这种方法还提供了有利的部署概况。
所有因子生成都是离线完成的,压缩模型保留了原始的FourceCIR地形,提示,正常化层,和恢复头.
因此,ASVD对挤压和量化起到补充作用:它减少了密集预测的代数成本,同时使精度降低和以痉挛为基础的加速可用于部署。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en:
We presented a training-free framework for accelerating transformer-based blind compressed image restoration.
An empirical analysis of prompt-based restoration transformers shows that projection operators dominate the parameter and MAC cost, that their singular-value spectra exhibit operator-dependent low-rank structure, and that their compressed-image activations are strongly channel-imbalanced.
These observations support TSVD as a principled training-free baseline and explain why a uniform low-rank approximation can fall short under aggressive rank budgets.
Building on this rationale, we formulated projection-level replacement with TSVD as the closed-form baseline and designed ASVD as our activation-calibrated refinement that incorporates lightweight activation statistics into the decomposition objective.
The resulting factors are generated entirely offline from compressed calibration inputs while preserving the original restoration architecture and inference flow.
Experiments on four standard blind CIR benchmarks show that ASVD consistently improves PSNR-B over TSVD at rank 64 under identical parameter and MAC budgets, while maintaining comparable PSNR and SSIM.
These results indicate that activation-aware factor generation can compress restoration transformers without retraining data, task-specific supervision, or online adaptation.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了加速基于变压器的盲压缩图像修复的无培训框架。
对即时恢复变压器的实证分析显示,投影操作者主导参数和MAC成本,其单值光谱显示操作者依赖的低阶结构,其压缩成像活化作用强烈的通道不平衡.
这些观察支持TSVD作为原则性无培训基线,并解释了统一低级近似为何在激进的军衔预算下可能不足.
基于这一理由,我们制定了以TSVD作为封闭式基线的预测级替换方案,并设计了ASVD作为我们的激活校准改进,将轻量级激活统计纳入分解目标.
由此产生的因素完全由压缩校准输入产生,同时保留原修复结构和推论流.
对四个标准盲CIR基准的实验显示,ASVD在相同的参数和MAC预算下持续改善PSNR-B比TSVD的排名64,同时保持可比的PSNR和SSIM.
这些结果显示,激活-意识因子生成可以压缩恢复变压器,而无需再培训数据,任务特定监督,或在线适应.

blocks.en:
The main evaluation uses a shared rank cap and one prompt-based backbone; a spectrum-based allocation study additionally examines non-uniform ranks under a matched MAC budget.
Promising future directions include further optimization of operator-wise or layer-wise rank allocation guided by spectral and activation profiles, combining ASVD with quantization and pruning for further compression, and extending it to other transformer-based restoration tasks.
blocks.zh:
主要评价采用共享等级上限和快速基干;基于频谱的分配研究在匹配的停战委员会预算下另外审查非统一等级。
未来有希望的方向包括以光谱和激活剖面为导向,进一步优化操作器或层位分配,将ASVD与量化和挤压相结合,以进一步压缩,并将其扩展到其他基于变压器的恢复任务.
